description: One line of survivors.jsonl as written by bulk_screen.py. This is the handoff format between the bulk screen and the vetting gauntlet: every record a screen emits must validate against this schema. Field names and units are exactly as written by the code — do not rename them without changing the writer and bumping the schema version.

alt_peaks.description: Up to two further distinct BLS peaks, for alias triage.

calibration_sha256.description: sha256 over the calibration CONTENT hashes (not just the labels): the profiles' bytes are part of the computation's identity.

calibration_version.description: Versioned calibration profiles that produced this record, as a per-subsystem map, e.g. {"bulk": "v1"} (see calibration/). Threshold changes bump the version; records from different calibrations are never silently mixed. A plain string is a legacy 1.1 record and still validates.

cdpp_pct.description: CDPP at the transit duration, percent — the pink-noise scale the MES rescore divides by.

clean_fold.description: Clean-data fold measurements behind clean_gate (quality==0 cadences only).

clean_gate.description: Clean-data re-fold gate verdict (bulk/clean_refold_gate.py), added by the gate — never by the screen.

control.description: True when this star is the run's positive-control TIC (screened like everyone else, excluded from novel-survivor claims).

duration_hours.description: BLS box duration, hours. This is ~half-depth width, NOT T14 — never feed it into duration checks.

input_identity.description: Which inputs this record was computed from: MAST product IDs, sectors, author, cadence, input file hash, selected-product manifest hash, and the hash of the arrays entering BLS.

known_source.description: Catalogue that already lists this object (toi, vsx, zooniverse), if the known-object filter caught it.

mes_pink.description: Pink-noise MES rescore (LEO-Vetter style, v1.1 calibration): depth / CDPP * sqrt(N_events).

mixed_pipeline.description: True when this record was produced by a run that resumed across a result-affecting code change under --accept-code-change (A-3): its run's records come from two pipelines. Absent on clean runs.

n_events.description: Number of observed transit events in the rescore window.

near_systematic.description: True if the headline period sits within 3% of a known TESS systematic period (e.g. the 13.7 d family).

odd_even_ratio.description: Odd/even depth ratio from the free vetoes. Far from 1 suggests an EB at twice the period.

period_days.description: BLS headline period, days. Single-sector periods carry errors up to ~0.004 d — never use as a fold anchor without refinement (see docs/vetting-manual.md stage 2).

pipeline_git_sha.description: Short git SHA of the pipeline code that produced this record ('unknown' when git was unavailable).

recipe_hash.description: sha256 of the RESOLVED recipe (after CLI overrides) for recipe-driven runs; absent when the run had no recipe.

run_id.description: Unique id of the run that produced this record, e.g. 'bulk-20261114T063000Z-a1b2'.

schema_version.description: Provenance schema version: '1.2' (current). '1.1' records are legacy and still validate.

sde.description: Robust signal detection efficiency of the headline peak.

secondary_depth_percent.description: Depth of any secondary eclipse, percent. A significant secondary is an EB marker.

status.description: Screen outcome. 'survivor' passed the survivor bar and goes to the gauntlet; 'recorded' passed the record floor but not the survivor bar; 'demoted' failed a free veto.

tic.description: TESS Input Catalog ID, as a string — the bulk screen carries TIC ids as strings throughout (file_star_list, the TOI join, the control check).

timestamp_utc.description: Run start, ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. 2026-11-14T06:00:00+00:00). One timestamp per run.

v_ratio.description: Folded profile edge/centre depth ratio (box ~1, V-shape << 1).

working_tree_clean.description: Whether the working tree was clean when this record was produced. A git SHA with no dirty flag misleads whenever uncommitted code runs. null when git was unavailable.

title: Bulk-screen survivor record
